newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's March unemployment rises to 2.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's March unemployment rises to 2.9 pct.

text.p: South Korea's seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate in March rose to a 41-month high of 2.9 percent from 1.9 percent a year earlier, provisional National Statistical Office (NSO) figures showed on Tuesday.

Note: Seasonally unadjusted figures in brackets. The NSO figures showed the economically active population rose to 21.46 million in March from 20.66 million a year ago and from 20.93 million in February.
The office sadi the March unemployment rate is the highest since October 1993 when it also hit 2.9 percent.
The jobless rate in the first quarter of this year stood at 2.6 percent, compared with 1.9 percent a year ago.
